note: Re-quoted 2026-11-25 to the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0; library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz, read offline as owb-am), per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 (Amharic quotes OWB everywhere). This supersedes what the notes below say about the 1962 UBS Bible and about wording borrowed from other Amharic works: every `mined` row is now a verbatim OWB span in its block (exact OWB pieces may be joined with '…'); `self_rendered` rows are allusions and paraphrases left as the translator's prose, each with its `why`. In Confessions the inventory-detected recitations (Rom 10:14, Col 2:8-9, Ps 41:4, John 5:14, John 1:1-5 and 1:10-12, Ps 25:9, Matt 11:29, Rom 1:21-22, Ps 148:7-12, Eph 5:14, Gal 5:17, Matt 19:21, Rom 13:13-14, John 7:39, Phil 4:11-16, 2 Cor 5:15, Matt 7:7-8, Ps 119:176, 1 Cor 3:1, Rom 12:2, 1 John 3:2, 1 Cor 2:11-12) now give OWB's words. Augustine's hundreds of woven allusions and Old Latin readings remain the translator's (self_rendered). Rows added or re-located in this pass carry chapter_order with a per-chapter block_index; the older self_rendered rows keep their earlier work-level indexes.

Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). Its New Testament is on disk (ebible mirror amh_amh); the mirror carries no Old Testament, so Augustine's constant Psalm and other OT quotations are self_rendered in the 1962 register.

The mirror misfiles or omits some NT verses (e.g. Romans 1:20-22, Ephesians 3:20, 1 Timothy 2:5, Philippians 2:15-16); translators pasted the text from where it actually sits when it was present and self-rendered the rest. A row is mined only when reported verbatim AND the block holds at least 45 characters (or the whole verse) of that verse's on-disk wording.
Augustine quotes the Old Latin, which often differs from the 1962 text; where his reading differs, his sense is kept and the row is adapted/self_rendered.
